estimator.why_not_pls: The frozen model is a one-component PLS fitted in R and cannot be reproduced exactly here. OLS is used for every arm so the comparison is internally apples-to-apples, and the frozen PLS arm is reported alongside as a labelled reference.

source.not_redistributed: Only the URL and both hashes are pinned, as for the RiboNN weights, the Rfam sources and the mRNAutilus checkpoint. The archive and table are not copied into this repository.

step: 3 of 3: refit on the source paper's free columns

step_2_skipped.what_was_skipped: installing EternaFold and reproducing its column locally
step_2_skipped.why: Step 1 showed the engines agree once properly normalised (AUP EternaFold -0.2648, AUP Vienna -0.2589, AUP DegScore -0.2170) and that the apparent EternaFold advantage was an artifact of dividing a sub-region sum by full RNA length. There is nothing for an engine swap to gain, so installing one would spend effort on a dead hypothesis.

the_defective_baseline_that_prompted_thi.corrected_comparison: Against properly normalised free structure scores the frozen calibration (+0.3200) WINS; the best is AUP EternaFold at -0.2648. The adverse finding survives in a different form: GC content (CDS), a single free column with no normalisation ambiguity, reaches +0.3651.
the_defective_baseline_that_prompted_thi.scope_of_the_error: Confined to two_axis_comparison_v1. On the 123-record Fig_S8a sheet the SUP columns are labelled FULL and SUP/length equals AUP FULL exactly on 123 of 123 records, so the post-hoc correction recorded in external_validation_leppek_v1 was correct and its -0.3248 figure stands.
the_defective_baseline_that_prompted_thi.what_it_actually_was: AUP multiplied by a region-length ratio. In this table SUP is summed over a sub-region whose implied length is median 673 nt, not the RNA length of median 1034 nt, so dividing by RNA length does not yield a per-nucleotide structure score.
the_defective_baseline_that_prompted_thi.what_was_reported: gate v14 recorded a free per-nucleotide EternaFold score at +0.4190 beating the frozen calibration at +0.3200, as the most adverse finding in any gate version
the_defective_baseline_that_prompted_thi.why_all_three_engines_clustered: They share the one artifact, not a common ceiling. That inference in the step 1 verdict was wrong for the right numbers.

verdict.criterion_amended: The protocol named the free EternaFold score at +0.4190 as the bar. That score is defective, so the bar is restated as the best VALID free single column, GC content (CDS) at +0.3651. The amendment is recorded rather than applied silently, and it lowers the bar, so it is stated explicitly.
verdict.success_criterion_declared_in_advance: the refit must beat BOTH the frozen arm and the best free single column; beating only the frozen arm is not success

what_this_cannot_establish: Nothing about the in-cell axis beyond the carried diagnostic; no coefficient is fitted to an in-cell label.
No resolution claim. The narrow bin is at chance for every predictor tested so far and a better Spearman does not by itself change that.
Nothing about the translation side. RiboNN is not run here.
No claim that a better in-solution ranker is the right objective for this project. Which axis the project targets is an open decision recorded in gate v14.
